claims.claim_en: 639.23 ha of fire still being extinguished.
claims.check_en: This is the area still burning that day, not the land that has burned this year. Auriga warned that it was being read as total damage. That day NASA's three VIIRS satellites recorded {det_2026-10-12} fire detections in Indonesia.
claims.check_id: Ini luas api yang masih menyala hari itu, bukan luas lahan yang terbakar tahun ini. Auriga mengingatkan angka ini dibaca sebagai total kerusakan. Hari itu tiga satelit VIIRS NASA mencatat {det_2026-10-12} deteksi api di Indonesia.

claims.check_en: Seven weeks later the province was under emergency response, with Palangka Raya's air index near 1,300 (14 Oct). In the week {week} Central Kalimantan's Suomi-NPP detections ranked {rank_ID-KT} of {of} since 2012.
claims.check_id: Tujuh minggu kemudian provinsi ini berstatus tanggap darurat, dengan ISPU Palangka Raya sekitar 1.300 (14 Okt). Pada minggu {week}, deteksi Suomi-NPP di Kalimantan Tengah berada di peringkat {rank_ID-KT} dari {of} sejak 2012.

claims.claim_en: Karhutla can be handled; only 6.9 ha left burning.
claims.claim_id: Karhutla bisa diatasi, tersisa 6,9 ha yang terbakar.
claims.check_en: Like the 639 ha figure, this measures fire still burning, not burned land. In the week {week} the three VIIRS satellites recorded {week3_ID-SS} detections in South Sumatra.
